fields: as a table: h, cols [field, what it proves, record], rows, fold, fold_noun. The column names show once as the log's legend (in each row for screen readers; shown per row on phones). The fold applies on phones only.
best_for: JointSpine shows a log as rows hanging off a pipe: a twin-wall pipe drops in beside the title, bends and runs down the log as its spine, and each row sits level with a numbered joint on it.

cols: What it proves in an audit
rows: Where this joint is in your plant
Joint map; number on the pipe
That both parts match their material certificates
That the welder was qualified on the day
That the qualified procedure ran with recorded settings
That the joint meets the acceptance criteria
That the set-up was proven before production joints
Test joint record; [test joint examination method]
How a rejected joint was replaced and accepted
New joint number linked to the original
